## Summary - **Desktop Large Widget Vertical Layout (`PowerNotchWidgets.swift`)**: - Merge the `1D / 7D / 30D` range selector into the trend card header row (`Trend [1D|7D|30D] ... Today/Last · Peak`) and switch the `Tokens / Spend / Reqs` pills to compact single-row chips. - Lay out 2-pool quota cards horizontally (ring on the left, label + 7d percentage on the right) and tighten 1-pool, 3–4-pool, balance, and empty-data quota sections as well as outer/switcher paddings. - Add a height-adaptive Y-axis (`minHeight: 56`, 3 ticks when `height >= 64` or 2 ticks when compact), trimmed integer axis currency formatting (e.g. `≈$50`, `≈$25`), top chart padding, and edge-anchored non-truncating X-axis labels (`Today` / `Now`). - **Notch Liquid Glass Fix (`NotchShape.swift`)**: - Bound and clamp the three dynamic `LinearGradient` stop locations (`0.0 < stop1 < stop2 < stop3 < 1.0`) so sine-wave drift never crosses stops or triggers Debug `Gradient stop locations must be ordered.` assertions. - **macOS Xcode Canvas Previews (`project.pbxproj`, `AIUsageWidgetIntents.swift`, `powerNotchApp.swift`, `PowerNotchWidgets.swift`)**: - Share `PowerNotchWidgets.swift`, `AIUsageWidgetModels.swift`, and `AIUsageWidgetIntents.swift` with the `powerNotch` app target via `PBXFileSystemSynchronizedBuildFileExceptionSet` so widget views can be previewed natively on macOS in Xcode Canvas. - Mark internal widget `AppIntent` types with `isDiscoverable = false` and guard `DynamicNotchApp` / `AppDelegate` startup when running under Xcode Previews (`XCODE_RUNNING_FOR_PREVIEWS` / `XCODE_RUNNING_FOR_PLAYGROUNDS`).
## Verification - `python3 -m unittest discover -s .github/scripts/tests -v`: 59 tests passed. - `swift test`: 10 tests (`NetEaseMusicTests`) + 121 tests in 17 suites (`AIUsageCoreTests`) passed. - `xcodebuild -project powerNotch.xcodeproj -scheme powerNotch -configuration Release ... build`: `** BUILD SUCCEEDED **`.
